question: In February 2025, the Technology Development Board signed an agreement with which company to produce purified pyrolysis oil to make circular plastics and sustainable chemicals?
solution:
The correct answer is __**APChemi Pvt. Ltd, Navi Mumbai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Technology Development Board (TDB)** signed an agreement with **APChemi Pvt. Ltd., Navi Mumbai**, in **February 2025** to produce purified pyrolysis oil for making circular plastics and sustainable chemicals.
 
• **APChemi Pvt. Ltd.** specializes in converting waste plastics into **high-value pyrolysis oil**, which can be further refined into sustainable chemicals and circular plastics.
 
• The collaboration aims to bolster the **circular economy** by promoting the reuse of plastic waste, reducing environmental pollution, and supporting sustainable industrial practices.
 
• Purified pyrolysis oil is a critical feedstock for creating **low-carbon plastics** and sustainable chemical solutions, aligning with India’s **green and environmental goals**.
 
• Through this agreement, the initiative aims to reduce the dependency on fossil fuel-based feedstocks in the production of plastics and chemicals, promoting the use of **recycled materials**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **APChemi Pvt. Ltd.**:

 
 
• Headquartered in **Navi Mumbai**, this company is a leading technology provider in the field of **waste plastic pyrolysis**.
 
• It operates advanced pyrolysis facilities that transform **non-recyclable plastic waste** into purified pyrolysis oil, which can be used in various industrial applications.
 
• APChemi has gained recognition for its **cutting-edge technology** and its commitment to sustainability and reducing plastic waste.
 
 
 
• **Technology Development Board (TDB):**
 
 
• The **Technology Development Board** is a statutory body under the **Department of Science and Technology, Government of India**.
 
• Its primary mission is to promote the development and commercialization of indigenous technology solutions in India.
 
• It provides financial assistance to industries and enterprises for innovative and environmentally sustainable projects.
 
 
 
• **Pyrolysis Technology:**
 
 
• Pyrolysis is a **thermal decomposition** process that converts organic materials, such as plastic waste, into useful by-products like **pyrolysis oil**, char, and syngas.
 
• The process operates at high temperatures in the absence of oxygen, ensuring that the materials break down into smaller molecules.
 
• Purified pyrolysis oil is increasingly being used as a **feedstock** for producing sustainable chemicals and circular plastics.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Circular Plastics:**
 
 
• Circular plastics are produced from recycled materials or sustainable feedstocks, reducing reliance on **virgin plastics** derived from fossil fuels.
 
• This approach helps in mitigating **plastic pollution** and contributes to achieving **climate goals** by lowering greenhouse gas emissions.
 
• The use of circular plastics supports the **United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)**, particularly those related to responsible consumption and production.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Other Options Explained:**

 
 
• **Tata Chemicals Ltd., Mumbai:** Known for its chemical and specialty products, it focuses on industrial chemicals, agricultural solutions, and consumer products but is not directly involved in pyrolysis oil production.
 
• **Jaypee Chemicals, Jaipur:** Primarily engaged in the manufacture of basic chemicals but does not specialize in sustainable plastics or pyrolysis technologies.
 
• **Adani Chemicals Ltd., Ahmedabad:** Part of the Adani Group, focusing on fertilizers and industrial chemicals, but not directly linked to purified pyrolysis oil production.
 
 
 
• **Environmental Impact:** The collaboration between TDB and APChemi addresses one of the most pressing environmental challenges—plastic waste management—by promoting recycling and sustainable practices.
 
• **Global Context:** The agreement reflects India’s commitment to the global shift towards a **circular economy** and aligns with **international efforts** to combat plastic pollution and climate change.
